evidence_direction_note: Governance governance-20260830-0630 ratified failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-964_2026-08-30.json (confirmed at 28d14475a5): V3-EXQ-964's C2 was STRUCTURALLY UNSATISFIABLE, so the run is not a negative result for MECH-482 and its recorded mixed is corrected to non_contributory. EpistemicDeficitAccumulator.reset() clears all persistent targets every episode, so in 60-step episodes n_targets never exceeds 1; with all 32 candidates matched the epistemic-deficit readout is a CONSTANT vector, and a constant cannot move an argmax. C1's PASS bar sits exactly where C2 must fail.
